$comment: Azure Static Web Apps route rules for the hosted AdminSecOps application (/tools/adminsecops/app/). Merged into the palanikumar.net staticwebapp.config.json by its scripts/build-adminsecops-app.mjs. The /tools/adminsecops/app route rewrites the canonical (no trailing slash) URL to the app's index.html. connect-src 'none' guarantees the page cannot send evidence anywhere (no fetch, XHR, WebSocket, EventSource or beacon).
csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; manifest-src 'self'; worker-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; media-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
